responses.B-SPB-006:
# Conversion paths: Prints, Workshops, Commissions

Reply promise used throughout: "I reply within a day." Anything I don't know is a [blank] for you to fill in.

**Greeting message** (WhatsApp Business sends it on a first message)
```
Hi, thanks for messaging [your business name]. Prints are in my shop: [your shop link]. Workshops are booked here: [your booking form link]. For a commission, tell me what you have in mind. I reply within a day.
```

## Prints: Buy
Path: button > [your shop link] (shop app) > customer orders > confirmation message > follow-up. If they message with a question instead, use the quick reply.

**Quick reply** (shortcut: `print-question`)
```
Thanks for asking about my prints. You can see them and order here: [your shop link]. Sizes and prices are in the shop. I reply within a day. [your business name]
```

**Confirmation**
```
Thank you for your order. I've seen it come through and will be in touch about [blank: packing and delivery details]. If anything looks wrong, message me here. [your business name]
```

**One follow-up** (send a few days after delivery, once you know it arrived)
```
Hi, I hope your print arrived safely and looks good on your wall. If you'd like to send me a photo of it, I'd love to see it. [your business name]
```
More follow-ups: **follow-up-planner**.

## Workshops: Book
Path: button > [your booking form link] > customer submits form > confirmation > reminder > follow-up.

**Quick reply** (shortcut: `workshop-info`)
```
Thanks for your interest in my workshops. Dates and details are on the booking form: [your booking form link]. Fill it in and I'll confirm your place. I reply within a day. [your business name]
```

**Confirmation**
```
Thank you for booking. Your place is confirmed for [blank: workshop name, date, time] at [blank: place]. Please bring [blank: what to bring]. Message me here if your plans change. [your business name]
```

**Reminder:** write this with **booking-confirmations**.

**One follow-up** (send the day after the workshop)
```
Thank you for coming to the workshop. I hope you enjoyed it. If you'd like to join another one, the booking form is here: [your booking form link]. [your business name]
```
More follow-ups: **follow-up-planner**.

## Commissions: Ask
Path: button > [your WhatsApp link] with a ready message > customer describes the idea > your first reply > agreed details > confirmation > follow-up.

**Quick reply** (shortcut: `commission-first`)
```
Thanks for asking about a commission. To get started, please tell me: what you'd like painted, the size you have in mind, and when you need it. I'll reply with next steps within a day. [your business name]
```

**Confirmation** (send after you've agreed the details in chat)
```
Thank you. Here is what we agreed: [blank: subject, size, price, timing]. I'll share payment details here once you confirm. I'll update you as it comes together. [your business name]
```

**One follow-up** (send if they went quiet after your first reply)
```
Hi, just checking in about your commission idea. If you'd still like to go ahead, tell me the size and timing you have in mind and I'll take it from there. [your business name]
```
More follow-ups: **follow-up-planner**.

## Weekly 15-minute check
Counts only, with no names or amounts.
```
Week of: [blank]
Page clicks (only if your tool shows them):
New inquiries:
Orders:
Bookings:
One thing to fix this week:
```

## Notes
- I can't send these, so you save the quick replies in WhatsApp Business and send each message yourself.
- Your shop app may send its own order confirmation. Check what it sends before you use the print confirmation.
- Automatic replies need the WhatsApp Business Platform through an approved provider. That is a builder project.
- Payment details (UPI or bank) go in chat only after the customer confirms. Keep them off the page and out of these templates.
